incident-bot: Pager: HIGH_SEV - smart-routing Fallback Oscillation detected for customer: AtlasRetail (EU region). Error spike: 502/524 and repeatedly hitting fallback to us-west then back to eu-central causing 2-7s latency spikes. Alerting oncall. runbook: /runbooks/smart-routing-oscillation

Ajay (oncall): on it. grabbing context from tracer and routing logs. can someone from runtime confirm if recent compat-matrix change went live?

Mara (eng-runtime): I just deployed a small update to compat matrix yesterday to mark model-variants as "quantized-compat: true" in some regions — I _thought_ only for alpha models. checking deploy now.

Sylvie (ml): quick note: we merged a change that relaxes the tool_calling_required flag for fp16 variants; that might change routing when tool calling is requested. could be relevant if requests include tools.

Leo (sre): I'm seeing a loop in routing decisions in the logs: requests to eu-central pick model: rwd-7b-fp16, then fallback to rwd-7b-quant in us-west due to capacity. But the fallback check then sees context-length mismatch and sends back to eu-central, repeat. frequency ~10-20 per minute for customer AtlasRetail.

Kris (support): customer reported "sudden latency and 502s in checkout autocomplete" about 12:12 UTC. They've paused traffic a bit but want ETA.

Ajay (oncall): ok mitigation plan: 1) add temporary policy to disable cross-region fallback for AtlasRetail 2) pin routing to fp16 variant in eu-central for their traffic 3) roll forward a compat-matrix hotfix if necessary. who can patch the policy?

Mara (eng-runtime): I can push a policy override for that org id. pushing rule now: `routes.override["org:atlasretail" ] = {allow_cross_region_fallback: false, preferred_variants: ["rwd-7b-fp16"]}`. applying in 30s. monitoring.

incident-bot: system: policy-update applied (id=pol-7732) by Mara. diff: -allow_cross_region_fallback: true -> false for org:atlasretail

Leo (sre): after policy update I'm seeing traffic stabilize to eu-central and error rate drop from 6% -> 0.8% in ~45s. latency mostly back to normal. still seeing some lingering cached routing entries causing a few more jumps. draining in-flight KV caches.

Sylvie (ml): timeline note: the compat-matrix entry for rwd-7b-quant in eu-central incorrectly flagged `context_max_tokens: 4096` while fp16 variant has 8192. that mismatch causes the runtime to reject quant fallback for long-context requests and triggers revert-to-origin route — creating the oscillation.

Mara (eng-runtime): found the matrix line (internal id cm-992): `rwd-7b-quant.eu-central: {supported: true, context_max_tokens: "4096", tool_calling: "false"}` should have been 8192 and tool_calling true. looks like a bad copy from a different region. patching now. Will send hotfix and also add a validation check.

Ajay (oncall): good catch. for immediate safety we kept cross-region fallback off for AtlasRetail. Once Mara's matrix hotfix is live we can re-enable fallback carefully.

Mara (eng-runtime): hotfix deployed to compat-matrix (change id cm-992-hotfix). New entry: `context_max_tokens: "8192", tool_calling: "true"`. also added a CI check that prevents context_max_tokens < variant_fp16_context for same-model families.

incident-bot: system: compat-matrix updated (cm-992-hotfix) by Mara at 1755557200.

Leo (sre): after hotfix and cache invalidation, I see fallback behavior returning to expected: quant fallback still available but not chosen for long contexts; cross-region oscillation resolved. Error rates stable. marking mitigations: policy-override + compat-matrix hotfix + cache invalidation.

Kris (support): informed AtlasRetail support contact: temporary routing override applied, hotfix deployed, working with engineering to re-enable fallback once monitored. customer asked for postmortem and whether their data was routed to us-west during failures.

Sylvie (ml): quick note for postmortem: root cause is bad compat-matrix metadata (copy/paste) for quant variant in eu-central + lack of validation that context_max_tokens must be >= origin variant. secondary contributor: relaxed tool_calling flags altered decision graph.

Ajay (oncall): action items: 1) Mara - PR with matrix validation and rollback test (due EOD) 2) Leo - automate detection of oscillating route patterns and auto-suppress cross-region fallback for affected orgs (P1 follow-up) 3) Sylvie - audit recent tool_calling flag changes across models for compatibility impact 4) Kris - coordinate customer PM/CS update + postmortem draft.

Mara (eng-runtime): ack. I'll open PR and link runbook snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/compat-matrix/pull/410 (WIP).

Leo (sre): I'll add a short alert rule to detect >5 route switches per minute for same request_id/trace and trigger a suppress policy.

incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated. timeline: 1755555555 alert -> 1755555845 policy override -> 1755557200 compat hotfix -> 1755558955 final verification. please file postmortem and link to this thread with timestamps.

Kris (support): filing CS ticket and will request confirmation if AtlasRetail wants fallback re-enabled. For now they're temporarily okay with the override.

Ajay (oncall): closing oncall handoff. leaving follow-ups in #eng-runtime and #eng-sre. thanks all. :thumbsup:
